senses.gloss: c., pl. לוּגְמִין (לגם, v. לְגִימָה) puffed up cheek (filled with a quaff); מלא ל׳ a mouthful, quantity of liquid filling one cheek.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 8:2">Yoma VIII, 2</cite>; Tosef. ib. V (IV), 3 <he>השותה מלא לוּגְמָיו וכ׳</he> he who drinks (on the Day of Atonement) a quantity equal to the fill of his cheeks; expl. Bab. ib. 80ᵃ and corrected <he>אימא כמלא ל׳</he> say as much as would cause the appearance of puffed cheeks. Y. ib. VII, 44ᵈ bot. [read:] <he>תני כמלא ל׳ ומהו פליג … ניתן ללוגמא אחת</he> there is a version (for <he>מלא לוגמיו</he>): <he>כמלא לוגמיו</he>, and what is the difference? (<he>כמלא לוגמיו</he> means) a mouthful which can be kept in one cheek. Ib. <he>לוּגְמוֹ של בן וכ׳</he> the mouthful of Ben Abatiaḥ which is more than a quarter of a Log; a. e.
